Call Kusum Harish Dharamshi of HD Fire Protect first. She is highest in the call queue, with ₹468.85 Cr associated with her IPO share sale. Dr. Dharminder Kumar Nagar of Paras Healthcare follows, with ₹300.00 Cr. HD Fire Protect’s Harish Narshi Dharamshi is also a promoter selling shareholder, with ₹243.46 Cr.

The listings were due on 21 Oct 2026 for HD Fire Protect and 28 Oct 2026 for Paras Healthcare, but listing notices have not yet been seen. Confirm the listings and whether the proceeds are in hand before treating the cash as available.
